name: @zavx0z/storybook
label: Storybook
description: Единый внешний сервер Storybook: навигация по структуре пакетов, документация и выполнение сценариев.

scripts.test: bun test --preload @immersive/headless/preload app tech chat project repo package specs domain component container contracts typedoc tests --max-concurrency=1 --path-ignore-patterns '{**/fixture/**,**/fixtures/**,**/isolation.integration.test.ts}' && bun test tests/isolation.integration.test.ts --max-concurrency=1
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.subjects:check: bun test --preload @immersive/headless/preload chat project repo package specs domain component container contracts typedoc --path-ignore-patterns '**/{fixture,fixtures}/**' --max-concurrency=1
